The *Meṇḍasirattheragāthā* (Thag 1.78) is a short verse text located within the single-verse section of the *Theragāthā* in the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text consists of an utterance associated with the elder (*thera*) Meṇḍasira [SuttaCentral].
In terms of parallels and text reuse, SuttaCentral identifies several resembling parallels across Pali and wider Buddhist verse literature, connecting it to Dhammapada verse 153 (Dhp 153), verses within the verses of the elders (*Sivakattheragāthā*, Thag 2.32) and the elder nuns (*Guttātherīgāthā*, Thig 6.7), as well as northern parallels in the Sanskrit *Udānavarga* (UV 31, *Cittavarga*), the Tibetan *Udānavarga* (Uv Kg 31), and Chinese translations including T 210.19, T 212.32, and T 213.31 [SuttaCentral].
